text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: “Dear Mom, how are things back home?”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“I'm doing great! Every single day is packed with so much, 
it makes my head spin in the best way!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Just the other day, our academy held a Triathlon! 
And guess what! I got to enter as a competitor too!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“It was SO much fun! Seeing everyone give their
absolute all was super inspiring—”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—The upperclassmen gave me so much courage. Just like them, 
I want to inspire everyone whenever I run!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So, I'm gonna keep sprinting forward alongside everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“Assemble! Tracen Academy Team Triathlon 
Tournament” …Triathlon tourney?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
An intra-school triathlon meet! Apparently co-hosted 
with a sporting goods manufacturer's anniversary campaign.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teams of 4… Dia-chan! 
We have to enter together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! You took the words right out of my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've always dreamed of joining a big school event like this…! 
Plus an anniversary festival sounds like a blast!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Your festival-loving spirit is raring to go, isn't it, Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You bet! Though Dia-chan, you look just as hyped as me~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Let's recruit our teammates right away!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's go ask our classmates!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Triathlon standard: swimming, cycling, running… 
Split into two run legs, 4-person relay format. 
Now that's a real workout!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Tailor-made for someone as athletically gifted 
as you, Ryan-oneesama. Are you planning to enter~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You bet! My muscles are already buzzing to go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ We certainly can't keep your muscles waiting~ 
If you'll have me, may I join your team, Oneesama?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You want in? Absolutely, glad to have you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Splendid~ This Mejiro Bright shall contribute 
every ounce of effort to support you, Oneesama~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let us secure victory together, Oneesama~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Look at you, all fired up! 
Counting on you, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Team triathlon rules… Oh, custom guidelines! Surfboards 
permitted in swim leg, and leg two has mini-challenges.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Challenge specifics revealed day of the event~ 
Sounds fun, gotta go scout some teammates♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—The sponsor is awarding luxury hotel buffet passes 
to the champions and special category winners?! 
A real all-you-can-eat feast?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Buffet means... all-you-can-eat, right? *drools*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Looks like the Triathlon will be broadcast on TV too! Ayabe-san, are you—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Not interested.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: An instant refusal...! Well, I sort of expected that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Still, teaming up sounds so exciting! Getting to run alongside girls with specialties you usually never face!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you entering, Top Road-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I'm just curious for now... Ah, I want to think it over carefully first!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A grand anniversary event! If I do not grace the stage, who shall uphold Tracen Academy's glory?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And for all the patrons who lavish my radiant form each day! The supreme Overlord shall deliver the ultimate opening act!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thinking of the academy and the sponsors too... Wah, as expected of Opera O-san~!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Natural duty for an Overlord! Now, time to assemble the cast!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Aha! "Showcase daily training results, make it a fiery, joyous festival worthy of Tracen! —From the Chairwoman"! It says!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oho! Time for the Class President to shine! I must take the lead and fire up this event!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho, Golshi-chan scored the ultimate pass: "Chairwoman's Orders!" Heck yeah, can't I just swap every bike for crawfish?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nah, dive right into the ocean and create a maelstrom! Where's the wildest team at?! Show yourselves!
